description: React reasoning vault for Forms, Validation & Data UX.

archetypes.name: React Hook Form Fundamentals Component Contract
archetypes.coreConcept: React Hook Form keeps field values in a form control and subscribes components to the state they need, limiting broad rerenders. A resolver connects schema validation to submission.
mentalModel: Identify the changing value and its single owner.
Trace one user event through the next render.
Verify the visible contract at empty and boundary inputs.
archetypes.governingInvariant: Each rendered result follows the current props/state snapshot; updates preserve the unit's lifecycle and accessibility contract.

cognitiveTraps.name: Stale or Duplicated UI State
cognitiveTraps.description: Mixing uncontrolled registration with a competing controlled value can desynchronize the field; submitting before resolver results settle can bypass the intended UX.
cognitiveTraps.reproducer: Exercise repeated updates and a boundary transition; check whether the rendered UI remains synchronized with its source.

qualityChecks.check: Every changing UI value has one clear owner, and derived values are computed from current inputs rather than stored as competing copies.
qualityChecks.why: Competing sources of truth drift after updates and produce stale screens.

knownBad.code: function Summary({ total }) { const [displayTotal] = React.useState(total); return <output>{displayTotal}</output>; }

qualityChecks.check: The component preserves the framework lifecycle boundary required by the unit and cleans up any external synchronization it starts.
qualityChecks.why: Ignoring lifecycle boundaries creates stale output, duplicate work, or leaked resources.

knownBad.code: function BadPanel({ value }) { React.useEffect(() => { window.addEventListener('resize', () => console.log(value)); }, []); return null; }
